Very good
Apr 2026 • Couples
No real complaints overall. We shared a nice, fresh tomato salad with a tasty balsamic glaze. We also tried the bruschetta, but it wasn't very flavorful and was a bit dry. My husband had the fajita sandwich, which was tasty and came with chips. I had the banh mi, which was packed full of ingredients and delicious. It’s not trying to be fancy — just good, hearty food done well, and we’d happily eat here again. Improving the bruschetta would bring the review to 5 stars. Good value!
